title: UCOPE B03: two fresh shared-data acquisition datasets
context: Claim: the shared-data count-conditioned return learner retains useful mean native acquisition gain over BLIND and IMMEDIATE-4 on two fresh datasets. Binding: systems / information flow; no multi-agent partial observability or non-stationarity in this finite host. P08 selects6501 then6502, with the same algorithm and complete600s each/1200s sum.

options.label: Execute the two datasets as carded
options.consequence: Keep the delegated selection and commission the original CM for minimal seed binding, checks and both sequential remote calls, retaining every score.

options.label: Stop unexecuted B03 work
options.consequence: Stop the unexecuted portion at a clean boundary and preserve all accepted calls, outcomes and historical science.

options.label: Revise the unexecuted card
options.consequence: Apply the specific revision before dependent execution and preserve the original record; no automatic extra seed or replay.

dm_reason: Two independent new datasets directly address the current single-seed uncertainty while preserving the native comparisons and every outcome.

packet.question: 是否保留P08已委托的B03卡片，使用6501、6502两个全新数据种子检查B02付费信息收益的延续性？

changes_if_approved.target: UCOPE B03 selected object and original CM assignment
changes_if_approved.from: B02只有一个数据种子的有效RM-A信号；两种子后续仅为建议
changes_if_approved.to: 前瞻冻结6501和6502，原CM最小种子绑定修订后顺序执行两次；第二次不依第一得分决定，两个新种子单独组成联合主指标

packet.if_refused: 在下一清晰边界停止尚未执行部分，保留已接受调用及全部结果，不改写B02，不擅自增加替代种子或改变方向状态。

evidence_for.quote: Both means are above 0.001 and FULL actually probes in 4,096 evaluation episodes.
evidence_for.why: 已有真实付费后的净收益，足以支持两个独立训练数据样本的有界后续，不能直接宣布稳定优越。

evidence_for.quote: A negative first score does not cancel or alter seed 6502.
evidence_for.why: 预先固定全部执行与主指标，保留负结果，避免只留下成功种子。

evidence_against.quote: BLIND deploys IMMEDIATE-4 everywhere; the two equal positive comparisons share the same effective reference and are not independent confirmation.
evidence_against.why: B02仍只是一个拟合样本，计数估计的最大值偏差和跨种子变化尚未检验。

uncertainty: 两个新种子也不足以证明稳定总体优越性，必须同时报告种子差异和条件评估噪声。
可能出现负收益或信息增量不足；所有分数保留，不安排第三次。
沿用相同算法的7.73秒历史耗时只是规划点，不能代替每次完整计时与新鲜资源准入。

cost.compute: 已选两数据集共720896回合、786432次标量更新；每次完整上限600秒，两次合计1200秒。规划点约15.46秒，不含暂存开销且不作保证。冻结时新增暴露为零。
cost.owner_time: 异步审阅种子、比较器和边界；授权范围内继续，不等待回复。
